worlds.name: People's Portfolio
worlds.thesis: The human story, research practice, work, and lineage behind the wider TRAI organism.
worlds.synopsis: People's Portfolio is the canonical personal portfolio world. It presents Jonathan Peoples as founder, researcher, builder, and community technologist without conflating that human story with the TRAI systems architecture.
worlds.transitionLine: Golden threads converge into the human story that anchors the organism.

worlds.name: TRAI
worlds.thesis: The systems world: ventures, sovereignty architecture, research, and regenerative connections.
worlds.synopsis: TRAI is the organism map rather than the personal portfolio. It connects materials, cybersecurity, community infrastructure, biological products, identity, mobility, and regenerative return as coordinated sovereign systems.
worlds.transitionLine: Sovereign orbital fields collapse into a crystalline route, carrying the living architecture between worlds.

worlds.name: True Mélange Φ
worlds.thesis: A Fibonacci-indexed formulation and cultural world built around the Blue-Gold Daily concept.
worlds.synopsis: True Mélange Φ combines formulation architecture, evidence boundaries, ritual language, and a sovereignty loop. The Φ layers are presented as a precise system in which mythology, sensory design, and documented function remain clearly distinguished.
worlds.transitionLine: A phyllotaxis field unfolds at the golden angle, revealing the Φ layer system.

worlds.name: Tamerian Materials
worlds.thesis: Advanced material research where carbon systems meet crystalline structure and energy-harvesting design.
worlds.synopsis: Tamerian Materials is the materials-science world of the organism. Its native cinematic experience remains intact; the organism adapter adds only a matched carbon-to-crystal gateway around that experience.
worlds.transitionLine: Orbital systems fracture into carbon vectors, then lock into a luminous crystalline lattice.

worlds.name: Queen Califia
worlds.thesis: A sovereign CyberAI command world centered on autonomous security, operational awareness, and controlled activation.
worlds.synopsis: Queen Califia is a dedicated command experience with its own cinematic awakening and Framer Motion handoff into the sovereign dashboard. The organism adapter deliberately wraps that experience rather than replacing its internal command choreography.
worlds.transitionLine: The command core acquires signal, verifies the route, and opens the sovereign interface.

worlds.name: TechBridge Collective
worlds.thesis: Community technology infrastructure built around access, Digital Navigators, hubs, help, and measurable impact.
worlds.synopsis: TechBridge is the community-facing infrastructure world. Its native visual language already centers bridge construction, progress, forest green, gold, and teal, so v5 uses span-and-node choreography for cross-world arrivals and leaves the existing cinematic intro and route design intact.
worlds.transitionLine: Connected nodes become a bridge span, carrying the organism into community action.
